title: The Lighthouse Ledger
summary: A new lighthouse keeper discovers a hidden ledger that reveals why the old keeper left so suddenly.

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: Kit standing inside a lighthouse lamp room at night holding an old notebook, stormy sea beyond the glass, no text

chapters.title: The Keeper's Secret
sentences: When Kit accepted the post at Gannet Rock, nobody warned her how lonely the lighthouse would feel.
The supply boat visited only once a fortnight, and the radio often crackled with nothing but noise.
On her third night, while searching for matches, she noticed a loose board beneath the old iron stove.
Underneath lay a leather ledger, swollen with damp, but still tied shut with a length of faded string.
The previous keeper, Mr Alder, had left the island in a hurry, and the harbour office had never explained why.
His handwriting was meticulous, with every entry listing the weather, the oil used, and the passing ships.
For years the numbers were perfectly regular, which made the final pages all the more strange.
In the last month, Alder had recorded a ship that never appeared on any official schedule.
The ship came at the same hour each night, showed no lights, and sailed straight past the rocks.
Kit felt her curiosity grow as her supply of candles began to dwindle in the storm.
She wondered whether Alder had abandoned his post out of fear, or whether someone had forced him to go.
By morning she had read the whole ledger twice, and she knew she could not simply ignore it.

quiz.q: Where did Kit find the ledger?
options: Under a loose board near the stove
quiz.explain: It lay beneath a loose board under the old iron stove.

quiz.q: What was unusual about the final pages?
options: They recorded a ship with no lights.
quiz.explain: Alder recorded an unscheduled ship that showed no lights.
It was meticulous, with every entry carefully listed.

chapters.title: Light on the Water
sentences: On the next clear night, Kit climbed to the lamp room and kept a silent watch by the great glass.
At exactly midnight, a dark shape slid across the water without a single light on its deck.
She felt a cold suspicion settle in her stomach, because the ship moved with the confidence of a regular visitor.
Then a small lamp blinked twice on the headland, and the ship answered with a signal from its stern.
Kit realised that someone on the island was helping the crew to smuggle goods past the coast guard.
Alder must have discovered the pattern, and perhaps he had left because he refused to take part.
She copied every detail into her own notebook, including the date, the time, and the direction of the signals.
When the supply boat arrived, she slowly handed the ledger and her notes to the harbour inspector.
The inspector listened carefully, and two weeks later a patrol vessel caught the dark ship at midnight.
Alder travelled back to the island, relieved, and he agreed to testify about everything he had seen.
He thanked Kit for the courage that he himself had lacked during his last difficult month.
That evening, she lit the great lamp as usual and watched its beam sweep calmly across an honest sea.

quiz.q: What did Kit see at midnight?
quiz.explain: A dark shape crossed the water without any light on its deck.

options: Someone on the island helped smugglers.
quiz.explain: She realised someone was helping the crew smuggle goods.

quiz.q: What happened after Kit gave the ledger to the inspector?
quiz.explain: Two weeks later a patrol vessel caught the dark ship.
